data_caveats: EEM 2008: the vendor's O=H=L=C zero-volume year is accepted as cached (never filled: the first EEM fill is >= the 2009-01-02 open, and the zero-ADV hold-prior rule keeps EEM flat until its 20-bar median dollar volume is positive)
EEM within-file duplicate stamps resolved keep-last (82 closes move <= $0.035)
GLD distributions header-only by issuer statement

EEM.detail: 22/22 Alpaca records match exactly, max |diff| 1e-7. Bar cache for EEM begins 2008-01-02 (the 2007-01-01_2017-12-31 parquet has no 2007 rows), so coverage is judged from 2008: 2+ ex-dates every year 2008-2025 (3 in 2009, 2010, 2012, 2021), 1 in 2026. No gaps. All 40 in-window ex-dates are cached sessions.
gaps: Bar cache starts 2008-01-02, not 2007; issuer CSV has 2007 records (2007-06-27, 2007-12-24) that fall before the cache and were not coverage-checked.

EFA.detail: 22/22 Alpaca records match exactly, max |diff| 0.0. Coverage from first cached bar 2007-01-03: 2 ex-dates every year 2008-2025 (3 in 2021), 1 in 2026 (June). 2007 has only the December ex-date (2007-12-24): the issuer table shows a December-only annual cadence for 2002-2007 with June+December starting 2008-06-25. Attempts to corroborate a missing June-2007 distribution against a third source failed (stockanalysis.com paywalls pre-2021 history; dividendhistory.org 404; nasdaq.com timed out), so 2007 is flagged as an unverified single-record year rather than a confirmed gap. All 39 in-window ex-dates are cached sessions.
gaps: 2007: only the 2007-12-24 ex-date is present (issuer table shows annual December-only cadence through 2007; semiannual from 2008-06-25). Not independently corroborated: third-party history sources were paywalled/404/timeout. If a June-2007 distribution existed it is missing from EFA.csv.

GLD.detail: Issuer file is header-only and Alpaca returns 0 cash-dividend records for GLD over 2016-01-01..2026-07-17, consistent with the no-distribution grantor-trust policy documented in the capture. Zero records expected, zero found, all years 2007-2026.

HYG.detail: 125/125 Alpaca records match exactly, max |diff| 0.0. Issuer 2016-08-01 (0.383153) absent from Alpaca (hole). Coverage from first cached bar 2007-04-11: 9 ex-dates in 2007 (May-Dec plus the second December; the April nominal ex-date precedes the first bar and the 2007-04-04 inception), 12 every year 2008-2025, 6 in 2026. 68 in-window amounts exceed the 0.5 heuristic ceiling, all in 2007-2013 (0.50-0.81, high-yield-era coupons); all 2016+ amounts match Alpaca. All ex-dates are cached sessions.

IEF.detail: 125/125 Alpaca records match exactly, max |diff| 5e-6 (Alpaca rounds some rates to 5 decimals). Issuer 2016-08-01 (0.158313) absent from Alpaca (hole). Coverage from 2007-01-03: 12 every year 2007-2025, 6 in 2026. 48 in-window amounts fall outside the 0.1-0.3 heuristic: 2007-2009 rows at 0.30-0.37 (higher-yield era) plus 2009-11-02 = 0.769909 which the issuer file itemizes as 0.260923 income + 0.508986 LT capital gain paid in cash; 2020-08..2021-12 rows at 0.070-0.100 (zero-rate era); 2024-12..2026-07 rows at 0.303-0.317. All are issuer-published and the 2016+ ones match Alpaca exactly, so they are plausible, not errors. All ex-dates are cached sessions.

LQD.detail: 125/125 Alpaca records match exactly, max |diff| 0.0. Issuer 2016-08-01 (0.322706) absent from Alpaca (hole). Coverage from 2007-01-03: 12 every year 2007-2025, 6 in 2026. 79 in-window amounts exceed the 0.4 heuristic ceiling: 2007-2012 rows 0.40-0.52 and 2024-2026 rows 0.40-0.45, consistent with IG yields in those periods; the 2016+ ones match Alpaca exactly. All ex-dates are cached sessions.

PDBC.detail: 11/11 Alpaca records match exactly, max |diff| 0.0; no unmatched on either side. Irregular annual December payer: years with records 2016-2025 (2 in 2021: 2021-12-03 and 2021-12-20), none 2014-2015 (corroborated in the capture by EDGAR N-CSRS financial highlights) and none in 2026 through the cutoff. All 11 ex-dates are cached sessions (first bar 2014-11-07).

SPY.detail: All 39 Alpaca records match issuer ex-dates exactly (no ±1bd shifts) with |diff|<=1e-7. 3 issuer records unmatched: 2016-03-18 and 2018-06-15 are absent from Alpaca even under narrow per-month queries (Alpaca data holes; issuer XLSX values 1.049604 and 1.245568 stand); 2026-06-18 (1.903516) IS in Alpaca but is returned only when the query end >= its pay date 2026-07-31 because the Alpaca corporate-actions start/end filter selects on process_date, not ex_date. Coverage from first cached bar 2006-09-27 (SPY_1d_min_2026-08-14.parquet) to 2026-07-17: 4 ex-dates every year 2007-2025, 1 in 2006 (Dec; Sep-2006 ex-date 2006-09-15 precedes the first bar), 2 in 2026 (Mar, Jun). Sanity: one in-window amount below the 0.5 heuristic floor, 2010-03-19 = 0.48038 (issuer value, 2010 low-payout quarter; not a data error). All 80 in-window ex-dates fall on cached sessions.

TLT.detail: 125/125 Alpaca records match exactly, max |diff| 1e-7. Issuer 2016-08-01 (0.258147) is absent from Alpaca even under a narrow 2016-07-25..2016-08-05 query (Alpaca hole shared by IEF/LQD/HYG on the same date). Coverage from 2007-01-03: 12 ex-dates every year 2007-2025, 6 in 2026 through 2026-07-01. All 234 in-window amounts within 0.15-0.45; all ex-dates are cached sessions. 2 post-cutoff rows (2026-08-03, 2026-09-01) in the CSV were excluded from the comparison.

UUP.detail: 7/7 Alpaca (2016+) records match exactly, max |diff| 0.0; no unmatched. Irregular December-only payer: years with records 2007, 2008, 2017, 2018, 2019, 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025; none 2009-2016, 2020, 2021, 2026 (pre-2016 years cannot be checked against Alpaca; the 2009-2016 absence rests on the issuer API alone). All 9 ex-dates are cached sessions (first bar 2007-03-01).
